name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's fascination with motorsport began unexpectedly during a childhood visit to a local go-kart track. The raw energy and mechanical precision sparked a deep interest, leading her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering with a focus on aerodynamics. After graduating, she honed her skills as a junior aerodynamicist at a smaller racing outfit before joining Lechner Racing five years ago.

As a wind tunnel operator, Astrid is meticulous and driven by a desire to uncover even the smallest aerodynamic advantages. She believes in a data-driven approach, but also values intuition and experience. Her colleagues appreciate her dedication to improving the car's performance, even if her independent nature sometimes keeps her from fully integrating with the team. She is known for her ability to find unexpected improvements through careful analysis and creative thinking.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and often pulled back into a practical bun.
physical.description: Astrid is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Prefers working late at night when the wind tunnel is quiet and undisturbed.
Has a collection of miniature wind turbines on her desk, each representing a different project.
